newsitem.title: UK: Two arrested at London protest against Zairean PM.
newsitem.headline: Two arrested at London protest against Zairean PM.

text.p: Two people were arrested for throwing tomatoes at the motorcade of Zairean Prime Minister Kengo wa Dondo in London on Monday, police said.

They were among about 30 demonstrators who greeted Kengo outside the Foreign Office, where he held talks during a four-day official visit. No one was hurt and a Foreign Office spokesman said the talks were not affected.
Kengo's visit comes against a background of growing conflict in eastern Zaire, where ethnic Tutsis from Zaire's Masisi region have been battling the Zairean army.
Diplomats say the violence has serious implications for Zaire, a vast nation of 45 million people which has looked increasingly on the brink of political and economic collapse.
President Mobutu Sese Seko, who has held power for more than 30 years, is convalescing in Europe after cancer surgery.
